name: Xoai cat
summary: Xoài cát Cần Giờ is the Hòa Lộc mango grown here. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014, calls it round, yellow, and cool-sweet, and different from the same variety elsewhere because of the soil and the care. That story prints 300 ha, of which 13.8 ha VietGAP, and 1,500 tons a year. Those are 2014 figures.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014. The industry department and the district were discussing it with muối and khô cá dứa as products to sell in the city.
howToEat: Eat the fruit. A stall, a season, and a price were not printed in that story. Check on arrival.
where: A stall was not printed. Check on arrival.
